sermon.title: Biblical Justice - The Power of God’s People Pt 6 — January 26, 2025
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: All are called to be mature disciples, keeping unity and choosing qualified leaders. Daniel served faithfully in government; an unjust law sent him to the lions, but God delivered him, justice fell on his accusers, and Darius honored God. Let God’s shaking start with you.
